label: Expected accuracy gain from a binary check
definition: For a fixed binary target, outcome weight w and conditional truth probabilities u,v, all in [0,1], the pooled prior is w*u+(1-w)*v. Accuracy gain is error at the optimal pooled credence minus the outcome-weighted sum of optimal conditional squared errors. The weights and conditional probabilities must come from the same assessment. No actual calibration or normative predicate is supplied.
note: Uses the existing expected binary squared-error measure. A check is a refinement of the supplied assessment, not necessarily an experiment or a proof. Zero value for the target does not entail zero value for method reliability, evidence access, or another proposition.
